description: Configurable dashboard with a CSS grid layout, drag-and-drop widget positioning, resize handles, edit mode, widget selector modal, multiple saved dashboards via IDashboardProvider, and JS interop for grid interactions. Renders directly on the workspace (Appearance=Plain) with a select-like dashboard switcher, optional Title/Subtitle and host HeaderActions; each widget card carries a 40px category icon tile with an optional description and a host WidgetHeaderActions slot.

parameters.name: Appearance
parameters.description: Chrome of the root surface. Plain (default) paints the dashboard directly on the workspace background — the widget cards are the only surfaces; Card keeps the pre-2.9.1 wrapping surface card (.tm-dashboard--framed) for hosts that embed the dashboard on a contrasting page.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Heading text in view and edit mode, overriding the current dashboard's name. Without a Title (and with a provider) the heading is visually hidden in view mode, because the switcher trigger already shows the name.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Secondary line under the heading in view mode. Empty hides it.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content at the start of the header, before the heading and the dashboard switcher (breadcrumbs, back link, page-level controls).

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host actions at the end of the view-mode header, rendered BEFORE the Edit button so the DOM order matches the visual (and tab) order. Not rendered in edit mode.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether the header toolbar renders in view mode. Edit mode always renders the toolbar, because it is the only surface carrying Save/Cancel.

parameters.name: ShowWidgetIcons
parameters.description: Whether the widget header renders the 40px category icon tile from the widget definition.

parameters.name: ShowWidgetDescriptions
parameters.description: Whether the widget header renders the definition's Description as a secondary line under the title.

parameters.name: WidgetHeaderActions
parameters.description: Host slot in every widget header (a badge, a view-all link, a period select), receiving the WidgetInstance. Renders before the collapse chevron in view mode only; the host owns its content's accessible names.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading (and subtitle) render at all. Different concern than ShowHeader: false still shows the switcher and the header actions.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto measures the dashboard. The grid reads the resolved mode: 12 columns on desktop, 6 on tablet, 1 on mobile, and 2 inside tablet below 768px of the dashboard container. A forced value restacks the grid and never measures.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement, forwarded to the observer. Desktop unless the host says otherwise.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered layout changes. Never pair LayoutMode with this callback: it reports the resolved mode, and a two-way bind would pin that mode.

parameters.name: CloseOnSelect
parameters.description: Whether selecting a widget in the widget selector closes it. With false the selector stays open while the host keeps receiving additions; the freshly added widget still gets the highlight and the scroll-into-view once the selector closes.

usedAbstractions.name: IDashboardProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Provider for dashboard widget data and persistence
